macros.name: Cybercontrolsincontentsenabledfalse
macros.doc: If there is a part of your document wherein you do not want section titles in the table of contents changed, at the beginning of that part write \Cybercontrolsincontentsenabledfalse.

macros.name: Cybercontrolsincontentsenabledtrue
macros.doc: When you want controls-in-contents re-enabled, write \Cybercontrolsincontentsenabledtrue.
